files.reason: Route only the dedicated batch branch through the existing authenticated current-source and frozen static-check path. Preserve every native generation, Scala, simulation, formal job, matrix and timeout.

The normal native allocator must preserve explicit signal spellings when a propagated weak name occurs earlier. Move reservation before allocation; retain duplicate explicit-name diagnostics and the existing generated-name suffix allocator. This is a native backend naming correction, not an RTL expression change. The existing compiler member callback supplies ElabInt binding hints to exact component-owned local-parameter records; names do not confer identity or authority.

Provide neutral typed integer and Boolean carriers. Preserve existing single-root coverage, root/schema identity, projection and arithmetic safety checks; route genuinely independent native arithmetic and predicates through private compositional proofs. Validate finished native owner scopes through the same authoritative single-root checker. Existing WA-11 Boolean encoding origins, integer sizing fences and single-root normalization remain intact. Separate native arithmetic/publication dispatch from explicit exact extrema queries. Keep exact/provenance validation and concrete/default width errors; use authenticated safe physical width only with a separate legality obligation. Capture typed arithmetic operands before normalization and retain presentation identity only through trusted unrestricted projection; no arithmetic, root or domain proof is changed.
Relocate the existing typed unsigned hardware-value adapter unchanged into core so the public core U overload can delegate without a reverse module dependency.

Provide exact finite-domain reasoning for parameter-sensitive native operations. Expose only a read-only active-restriction query so deferred requirements cannot escape captured branches; exact-domain authority and projection checks are unchanged. Expose a read-only admitted-root query so exact native captured owners can validate retained obligations after dynamic scope restoration.

Private identity-bound compositional value-function proofs over authenticated declaration roots and schemas. Preserve all dependency axes including canceled and branch-restricted roots, join partially overlapping dependencies, compose attainable extrema for independent groups, and fail closed beyond bounded exact joint evaluation. Bind publication evidence to exact native owners without fabricating a single-root domain or enumerating large Cartesian products. Retain private expression-identity AST certificates and authentic root/schema/scope inventories independently of exact proof. Derive checked compositional publication enclosures without Cartesian calls; keep the existing stronger exact evaluator on demand and authenticate safe physical width as its own AST. PR189 adds a one-use analyzer-bound compact declaration; retains the exhaustive cap and rejects unsupported structural/owner enumeration. Retain private, exact-condition-bound finite structural tuple evidence under the unchanged 65,536 tuple cap. Classify diagnostics under authenticated activation without granting integer or width authority; compact and oversized structural products remain rejected.

Relocate the existing exact value/leaf/assignment registry unchanged into core alongside its adapter. Preserve all freshness, owner and authority validation; this is not a new copyable proof mechanism.
Add the explicit fixed-width unsigned ElabInt value overload, delegating to the existing exact typed value registry. Existing literal overloads and native arithmetic remain unchanged.

Capture exact typed arithmetic operands and compiler-supplied member hints; select only live exact-owner uses, order declarations by operand identity, reject cycles, reserve collision-safe names, and render native local parameters without introducing proof authority. Restricted structural calculations retain direct expression publication. Component-owned state cannot leak names between generations or owners. Extend the existing component-local dependency graph with explicitly named packed unsigned declarations, exact owner checks, deterministic collision rejection and dependency ordering. Explicit names replace an automatic hint for the same expression; metadata never grants arithmetic authority.

Private exact-Component-owned legality obligations accept authenticated native typed ASTs, never fabricated exact-domain evidence. Preserve root/schema dependencies used only in require. Originally reject mixed structural-scope obligations; now reject them without an exact activation owner, render escaped diagnostics inside synthesis guards, and pair safe physical-width publication with raw positivity diagnostics. Failed requirements emit one $fatal(1, "%s", message) with the original message treated literally, not a recoverable $error or duplicate report. PR189 adds a one-use analyzer-bound compact declaration; retains the exhaustive cap and rejects unsupported structural/owner enumeration. CDC-LEG-01 changes only native diagnostic presentation: allocate G_PARAMETER_LEGALITY_<index> in the existing component name scope and pass the escaped original message directly to $fatal(1, "%s", message). Domain classification, record ownership, ordering, fatal termination and synthesis guards are unchanged. Increment 65 replaces the structural-scope rejection only for exact runtime-issued owners: component-local records carry full activation, root inventories and transactional rollback. Scope classification can omit implied diagnostics; active false requirements stay deferred, while unconditionally false top-level requirements still reject. Validate finished owner identity before native synthesis-guarded fatal publication. Retain validated declaration-domain guards for the explicit native formal API so downstream overrides cannot silently leave the proved domain. Existing user requirements retain their prior classification, scope, escaping and fatal semantics.

Own exact packed-width metadata and reviewed typed primitive adapters while retaining the historical deprecated factory aliases. Preserve recursive authored clone layout before copying metadata, retain exact native graph-derived scalar widths, and update fresh mux clone metadata only after the full native maximum-width proof. Retain private calculation and trusted projection-origin metadata on exact expression objects; public case-class copies deliberately inherit neither field. Add an internal typed-local owner marker to exact expression presentation metadata, preventing foreign constant dependencies without granting or changing width/domain authority.

Provide immutable exact-owner packed unsigned local constants, checked width/range, eager dependencies, fresh native reference nodes and full-domain switch disjointness validation. Named references are not literals and cannot be folded to their default witness.

Retain native symbolic-legality publication and the generation-scoped signed declaration, cast, literal, resize and unsigned-transport callbacks. The typed expression planner controls optional wrapper suppression; every mandatory wrapper present before depth cutting remains, and CDC-WIRE-01 suppresses new depth wrappers only when complete expansion and all receiving widths are proven. Approved unsigned expression slices use a deterministic Verilog-2001 function with the full authoritative source input width and exact constant result range, preserving truncation and four-state semantics. Helper and argument names are allocated in the same namespace after reserving component/width parameter identities, and functions are cached by symbolic width and range. Signed/unknown or otherwise unproven expressions and the ordinary backend keep inherited emission. Qualification repair reserves declaration-local width names without composing finished branch domains, and passes the exact emitter owner when preserving a retained unsigned wrapper's authoritative logical range. All old public wrapper entry points and ordinary backend behavior remain intact. Emit dependency-ordered typed local parameters through the native localparams buffer after the parameterized backend prepares exact live uses. Delegate exact assignment sources, targets and captured procedural scopes through a default-disabled owner-bound publication policy. Render immutable typed local references as native expressions and case labels. Existing process partitioning, assignment order and concrete emission remain authoritative.

Preserve structured parameterized-Verilog diagnostics across the inherited Verilog elaboration retry boundary. Expose read-only per-context execution state before any phase runs without altering native phase order or behavior. Mechanically copy immutable named-constant reference tokens through ordinary anonymous carrier propagation and validate exact named-key disjointness before native parallel-case emission. Never fold a symbolic default witness or alter ordinary literal propagation and coverage checks.

Generation-scoped default-disabled signed declaration, same-atom cast, literal, exact symbolic resize and function-range callbacks. Ordinary native emission and intermediate-width wrapper planning remain unchanged. Keep the historical VerilogBase interface stateless: default accessors delegate only to an opt-in, instance-owned DeclarationPolicyOwner; concrete PhaseVerilog supplies that capability without changing printer results. CDC-WIRE-01 qualification preserves the historical two-argument wrapper method and adds an internal owner-checked overload for retained unsigned symbolic carriers. The default backend remains on inherited concrete emission; signed declaration policy ranges retain precedence, with no new state in the historical interface. Add a default-disabled exact-occurrence scalar range callback so the native printer can reference module-local typed constants without changing ordinary concrete emission. Add owner-checked optional assignment/source/target/scope callbacks with storage confined to DeclarationPolicyOwner. Keep the historical interface stateless, preserve existing declaration and signedness hooks, and retain default native printing when no policy applies.
Accept an immutable owner-checked unsigned local constant as one native switch key, requiring an exact selector width. Existing key consumers and scope construction remain unchanged.
